hy-memory-30b-a3b-q8-gguf.notes: Tencent's official Q8_0 GGUF of Hy-Memory-30B-A3B (hy_v3 MoE, about 3B active), the memory-writer comparison candidate (#603). The GGUF embeds the base repository's chat_template.jinja byte for byte, so no template sidecar is pinned. Needs llama.cpp with hy_v3 (merged 2026-07-13; publisher-validated at 5aeac37a): served on demand as hy-memory-30b-a3b by plain llama-server from nixpkgs-fresh (modules/hy-memory.nix), not Gufo. Evaluation route only since 2026-11-09: it keeps a role only if it clearly beats well-prompted Flash-Next on a consequential memory-writing operation.
